授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）:
Students learn the basics of living organisms, including cells, genes, and proteins.
Introductory Biology I will deal with an overview of cell and chemical fundamentals of biomolecules by following the first three chapters of Essential Cell Biology textbook.

This lecture is opened primarily for IUPE students, but other undergraduate course students are also welcomed as long as they can follow the contents in English.
